- [FACT] User provided details about the Pap smear results: combined moderate dyskaryosis / HPV (LSIL and HSIL).
- [FACT] User described the findings on the Pap smear: two superficial intermediate squamous cells with koilocytotic changes and dyskaryotic nuclei (1) and a dyskeratotic cell “button” (2) suggesting CIN 1 and HPV infection (LSIL).

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained that CIN stands for "cervical intraepithelial neoplasia," referring to abnormal cell growth on the cervix.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant described the grading of CIN: CIN 1 (mild dysplasia), CIN 2 (moderate dysplasia), and CIN 3 (severe dysplasia or carcinoma in situ).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided information on further questions to ask Mrs. Woo regarding her menstrual history, sexual history, obstetric history, history of cervical cancer, family history, other medical history, and other symptoms.
